items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: that combination with him playing the tenor and then Yasushi playing bass, you know, kind of has this certain earth tone to it

ctx.x: I mean orchestration is a big part of pulling this —

Yeah, well I like, especially with Marcus Strickland — one, I’m just a big fan of his music and his work and the way he plays his instrument. But also he’s an amazing doubler, you know and he plays almost all the woodwinds too. But he’s such a master at bass clarinet, you know, and that was something that he was starting to do more of, and so when we were playing together it was like, “Man, bring your clarinet.” You know? Because it has such a nice, woody, warm, earthy tone to it you know, especially the way he…
Nice. You did music college. Was it Manhattan you went to?
